integrity: The generalized Gram lemma, counting reduction, and all instantiated constants are supplied explicitly. Finite exact arithmetic checks corroborate constants but are not used as an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: The zeta-function inequality is conditional on the energy bound and seven-point local inequality stated as Propositions 5 and 6 of arXiv:2609.33043v1; those imported analytic/computer-assisted inputs are not independently re-certified here. The maximal block statement concerns only the same seven-point pressure scheme.
title: Triple-zero stability for distinct Riemann zeta zeros
